categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet spend and fee-bumping logic in `src/wallet/spend.cpp` and `src/wallet/feebumper.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Prevents wallet fingerprinting caused by anti-fee-sniping randomly backdating `nLockTime` on RBF replacement transactions below the original transaction's locktime. While privacy and fingerprinting protections matter in wallet transaction generation, this is a subtle edge-case anomaly occurring roughly 10% of the time during fee bumps, making it a worthwhile but deferrable fix.
